content: Nvyalo kufuma pali Adamu mpaka pali Noa
Keki i kitabu kya nvyalo yakua Adamu.
Leza lu-aalengele muntu, waamukitile wapaleene ni Leza.
Leza waalengele mwalalume ni mwanakazi, waabapaalile ni kubenika liina lya muntu bobo busiku bubaalengelue.
Adamu lu-aakumaniizie myaka 130, waavyele mwana mwalalume mu lukebu lwakue, wapaleene nakue ni kumwinika Seti.
Pa kyamba kya kuvyala Seti, Adamu waikeele pa kyalo myaka 800 ni kuvyala bange baana balalume ni banakazi.
Adamu waafwile wali na myaka 930.
Seti lu-aakumaniizie myaka 105, waavyele mwana mwalalume ni kumwinika Enoshi.
Pa kyamba kya kuvyala Enoshi, Seti waikeele pa kyalo myaka 807 ni kuvyala bange baana balalume ni banakazi.
Seti waafwile wali na myaka 912.
Enoshi lu-aakumaniizie myaka 90, waavyele mwana mwalalume ni kumwinika Kenani,
pa kyamba kya kuvyala Kenani, Enoshi waikeele pa kyalo myaka 815 ni kuvyala bange baana balalume ni banakazi.
Enoshi waafwile wali na myaka 905.
Kenani lu-aakumaniizie myaka 70, waavyele mwana mwalalume ni kumwinika Mahalaleli.
Pa kyamba kya kuvyala Mahalaleli, Kenani waikeele pa kyalo myaka 840 ni kuvyala bange baana balalume ni banakazi.
Kenani waafwile wali na myaka 910.
Mahalaleli lu-aakumaniizie myaka 65, waavyele mwana mwalalume ni kumwinika Yaredi,
pa kyamba kya kuvyala Yaredi, Mahalaleli waikeele pa kyalo myaka 830 ni kuvyala bange baana balalume ni banakazi.
Mahalaleli waafwile wali na myaka 895.
Yaredi lu-aakumaniizie myaka 162, waavyele mwana mwalalume ni kumwinika Enoki,
pa kyamba kya kuvyala Enoki, Yaredi waikeele pa kyalo myaka 800 ni kuvyala bange baana balalume ni banakazi.
Yaredi waafwile wali na myaka 962.
Enoki lu-aakumaniizie myaka 65, waavyele mwana mwalalume ni kumwinika Metusela.
Pa kyamba kya kuvyala Metusela, Enoki waendele pamo ni Leza myaka 300, kabili waavyele ni bange baana balalume ni banakazi.
Enoki waafwile wali na myaka 365.
Enoki waendele pamo ni Leza, kabili taamwenekele pantu waatwemue na Leza wakosele.
Metusela lu-aakumaniizie myaka 187, waavyele mwana mwalalume ni kumwinika Lameki,
pa kyamba kya kuvyala Lameki, Metusela waikeele pa kyalo myaka 782 ni kuvyala bange baana balalume ni banakazi.
Metusela waafwile wali na myaka 969.
Lameki lu-aakumaniizie myaka 182, waavyele mwana mwalalume
ni kumwinika Noa.
Waalandile evi, “Ozu i waakatusansamusia kukonkana ni miilo ikolele itulitwabomba pa kyalo kyaatiipilue na Yawe.”
Pa kyamba kya kuvyala Noa, Lameki waikeele pa kyalo myaka 595 ni kuvyala bange baana balalume ni banakazi.
Lameki waafwile wali na myaka 777.
Noa lu-aakumaniizie myaka 500, waavyele Shemu, ni Hamu, ni Yafeti.

footnotes.text: 5.29 Noa: Leli liina lya Noa mu Kiebrania i kulanda nangue “kutuuzia.”
